personality_one_liner: A bright, clean, and highly professional education management app focused on utility and clarity.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room. Cards must use horizontal padding and never flush to the screen edge. Use gap: md for 2-column grids.

do's: Apply to sticky headers over scrolling content
Apply to floating action buttons or sticky CTAs at the bottom
dont's: Do not apply to form fields or list rows
Do not apply to general cards

screens.name: Beranda (Dashboard)
screens.purpose: Provides a quick overview of today's activities, low credit alerts, and unpaid invoices based on the user's role.

states.loading: Centered spinner with a skeleton of the stats grid.
states.empty: No alerts to show. An empty clipboard illustration with 'Semua aman terkendali' (All clear).
states.error: Error loading dashboard data. Retry button.

screens.layout: Header with 'Selamat Datang' and date. A 2-column grid for summary cards (e.g., Siswa Kredit Tipis, Tagihan Belum Dibayar) using prominent typography for the numbers. Below, a vertical list of today's classes to jump straight into attendance.

screens.name: Presensi (Attendance & Classes)
screens.purpose: Lists all 8 classes and allows the teacher to record daily attendance, deduct credits, or track 'izin' and 'pengganti'.
screens.layout: Class List: Large tappable image cards (Gymnastics/English) with class names. Class Detail: Date selector at top. Scrollable list of students. Each row has Student Avatar, Name, Remaining Credits badge, and a horizontal segmented control for (Hadir, Izin, Alpha, Pengganti). Sticky 'Simpan Presensi' (Save) button at the bottom.

screens.name: Siswa (Student Database)
screens.purpose: A comprehensive directory of students, showing their program, remaining credits, and izin quotas.

states.empty: No students found. Add a new student.

screens.layout: Persistent search bar. Single-column list of student rows. Detail screen uses a clean card layout to display stats: 'Sisa Kredit', 'Kuota Izin', 'Kelas Pengganti', and transaction history.

screens.name: Tagihan (Billing & Invoices)
screens.purpose: Manages billing for students whose credits have run out, including mark-as-paid and WhatsApp reminders.

states.empty: No invoices pending. Display empty clipboard illustration.

screens.layout: Top segmented control (Belum Dibayar, Lunas). Clean list of invoice cards with Student Name, Program, Total, and Status Pill. Invoice Detail: Breakdown of payment, 'Tandai Lunas' (Mark Paid) primary sticky CTA, and a secondary 'Kirim Tagihan via WA' (Send via WhatsApp) button.

gymnastics_class_hero.alt: Kids stretching in a gymnastics class

english_class_hero.alt: Wooden letters on a table for kids learning English

empty_state_invoices.alt: An empty white clipboard on a desk

instructions_to_main_agent: Adhere strictly to the iOS-Native Clean personality. Use generous padding, highly legible 'Plus Jakarta Sans' fonts with a maximum weight of 500, and ensure all interactive touch targets are at least 44x44pt.

BANNED COLORS: Do not use any blue, purple, indigo, orange, or terracotta. The primary brand color is a bright, fresh green (#22C55E). The secondary tone is a warm gray or muted neutral. Keep the UI bright ('cerah') through ample white space and vibrant green accents.
Role-based Navigation: Implement dynamic rendering based on role (Guru vs Keuangan). Teachers focus on 'Presensi', while Finance focuses on 'Tagihan'.

Attendance Toggles: Use a segmented control inline for each student with clear labels (Hadir, Izin, Alpha, Pengganti). Ensure the UI instantly reflects state changes and uses haptic feedback (`impactMedium`).
Credit Logic UI: Display the 'Sisa Kredit' (Remaining Credits) prominently next to the student's name during attendance taking so teachers can see when a student is at 0.

Billing CTA: The invoice detail must feature a prominent, sticky primary button for 'Tandai Lunas' (Mark Paid) anchored to the bottom using KeyboardAvoidingView and safe area padding. Below or beside it, include a 'Kirim Tagihan via WA' (WhatsApp) button.

Image Scrims: When displaying the Gymnastics or English class hero images with text overlaid, you MUST use a top-to-bottom linear gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) to guarantee WCAG text readability.
Use standard UI state handlers: Ensure every screen has Flex: 1 and explicitly implements Loading, Empty, and Error states gracefully.
